rule: Require a well-formed matching 506/507 pair, SleepEntered=true and positive OS SleepDurationInUs. Sleep interval is exit UTC minus SleepDurationInUs through exit UTC. Strict positive intersection, exceeding 2ms, with the operation/capture window is required. UTC is correlation only; monotonic operation duration remains authoritative. Unknown, malformed, unqueryable or clock-inconsistent evidence never invalidates a sample.
window: Resource: pre-capture request cutoff through post-capture acknowledgement, or failure observation if no post acknowledgement. Stress: start of repetition through completed cleanup. Retrospective resource uses the same retained timestamps.
